What is CGCUET?

CGCUET at CGC Mohali is a Scholarship test for higher education. Candidates who are seeking for financial assistance to pursue higher education in Engineering, Management, Commerce, Law, Computer Application, Jorunalism or Science courses must appear for the exam. The scholarship is provided for the UnderGraduate programmes only. The CGCUET Scholarship is distributed based on the points obtained in the exam. CGCUET Applications Open: Start Your Application Now

The CGCUET exam is a Scholarship Test for admisison to CGC Jhanjeri. This exam is conducted for candidates interested in fields such as Engineering, Management, Commerce, Law, Computer Application, Journalism, and Sciences.

CUCET registration 2026 is ongoing for phase 1. Candidates can apply for upcoming phase of CUCET 2026 till February 14. Candidates can fill the CGCUET application form 2026 in online mode only. Candidates must make sure to fulfil the prescribed eligibility criteria to get scholarship.

CGCUET is conducted twice in a year. The first stage of CGCUET is conducted from December to May and the second stage of CGCUET is held from June till August end.
